properties.name: Hat Yai core - municipality and U Taphao canal reach
properties.name_th: หาดใหญ่ (เขตเทศบาลและคลองอู่ตะเภา)
properties.adm3_covered: Hat Yai municipality and adjacent Khlong Hae / Khu Tao reach
properties.derivation: Square tile centred on the Hat Yai study point POINT(100.47 7.01) used by the hat_yai_2025 CDSE profile in src/floodguard/cdse.py, sized to a single THEOS-2 PMS footprint.
properties.purpose: Second development event. Dense urban canal-basin flooding is a different terrain regime from the Mae Sai border valley, which is what the immutable multi-event partition contract needs.

requested_windows.label: Flood event window
requested_windows.revision: narrowed and cloud limit lowered from 80%
requested_windows.measured_evidence: 2025-12-03 at 39.3% AOI cloud (AOI-03) and 40.2% (AOI-04); 2025-12-01 at 63.8% / 50.7%. Both inside the requested window.
requested_windows.note: A genuine partial-visibility opportunity during the flood. This is the most realistic flood-period optical chance in the whole request and should be treated as high priority despite the cloud.

requested_windows.label: Pre-event clear baseline
requested_windows.measured_evidence: Only 1 of 38 observed dates between 2025-03-01 and 2025-07-31 fell below 10% AOI cloud: 2025-03-31 at 3.0%. Next best was 2025-07-14 at 14.4%.
requested_windows.note: Deliberately narrow. The original five-month request at 10% cloud would have returned almost nothing; southern Thailand is far cloudier year-round than the north.

requested_windows.label: Post-event clear baseline
requested_windows.note: First reliably clear period after the November 2025 event.

properties.cloud_metric: max_cloud_pct is the AOI-clipped Sentinel-2 SCL measurement from scripts/scout_theos2_aoi_cloud.py and is what determines whether an acquisition is usable. portal_scene_cloud_filter_pct is the scene-level value to enter in the GISTDA ordering portal, which filters over the whole satellite footprint rather than the AOI; entering the AOI value there would discard usable dates. See outputs/theos2_aoi_cloud_scout.csv and outputs/theos2_portal_cloud_thresholds.csv.
properties.redistribution_intent: None. Imagery stays in a controlled workspace outside version control. Only derived, checksum-tracked evidence is committed.
